questions.question: Pipe A, B and C can fill a tank in 10 minutes, 6 minutes, and 18 minutes respectively. Find the time taken to complete the work if pipes are working alternately for 1 minutes each starting from A.
questions.question_hi: पाइप A, B और C एक टैंक को क्रमशः 10 मिनट, 6 मिनट और 18 मिनट में भर सकते हैं। यदि पाइप A से शुरू करते हुए एकांतर रूप से प्रत्येक पाइप को 1 मिनट के लिए खोला जाता है, तो टैंक को पूरा भरने में कितना समय लगेगा।
questions.solution:
Capacity of tank = LCM of 10, 6 and 18 = 90 units

Efficiency of pipe A = 90/10 = 9 units

Efficiency of pipe B = 90/6 = 15 units

Efficiency of pipe C = 90/18 = 5 units

Part of work got completed in 3 minutes = (9 + 15 + 5) unit = 29 unit

Part of work got completed in 9 minutes = 29 * 3 = 87 unit

Time taken to complete remaining work = (90 - 87)/9 = 3/9 = 1/3 minutes or 20 seconds

Total time = 9 minutes 20 seconds

questions.solution:
First car travels for 3.5 hours, so total distance covered till point C from point A = 3.5 * 50 = 175 km

Another car travels for 2.5 hours, so total distance covered till point C from point B = 2.5 * 40 = 100 km

Required ratio = 175: 100 = 7: 4

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 5.6 m. If side of the square is 20 cm more than the breadth of the rectangle and is 10 cm less than the length of the rectangle, then what is the perimeter of the rectangle (in m)?

questions.solution:
The perimeter of a square is 5.6 m.

=> 4 * side = 5.6 * 100

=> side = 140 cm

So, breadth = 140 - 20 = 120 cm

And length = 140 + 10 = 150 cm

So, perimeter of the rectangle = 2(150 + 120) = 540 cm = 5.4 m

questions.solution:
When every observation is multiplied by 3, the standard deviation is also multiplied by 3.

Addition of 5 does not affect the standard deviation.

New standard deviation = 6 * 3

= 18

questions.question: In a class of 100 students, 36 take science, 52 take art, and 4 take both science and art. What are the odds against that a student in the class is not enrolled in either science or art?
questions.question_hi: 100 छात्रों की एक कक्षा में, 36 विज्ञान, 52 कला तथा 4 विज्ञान और कला दोनों लेते हैं। कक्षा में किसी छात्र के या तो विज्ञान या कला में नामांकित न होने के प्रतिकूल संयोगानुपात कितना है?
questions.solution:
P(Science) = 36/100

P(art) = 52/100

P(science ∪ art) = 36/100 + 52/100 - 4/100

= 84/100

P(science ∪ art)c = 1 - 84/100 = 16/100 = 4/25

We know that odds against of an event E = P(Ec)/P(E)

Odds against that a student in the class is not enrolled in either science or art = (25 - 4)/4 = 21/4

Speed of Zoya by foot = 5 km/h

Time taken = 7 hours

Distance travel by foot = 5 X 7 = 35 km

Speed of Zoya by car = 15 km/h

Time taken = 3 hours

Distance travel by car = 15 X 3 = 45 km

Average speed = Total distance/total time taken

= (35 + 45)/(7 + 3) = 8 km/h

questions.question: In the given figure, a circle is inscribed in ∆PQR, such that it touches the sides PQ, QR, and RP at points D, E, F, respectively. If the lengths of the sides PQ = 47 cm, QR = 39 cm, and RP = 41 cm, then find the length of PD.
questions.question_hi: दिए गए चित्र में, त्रिभुज PQR में एक वृत्त अंकित है, जो PQ, QR, और RP भुजाओं को क्रमशः बिंदुओं D, E, F पर स्पर्श करता है। यदि भुजाओं की लंबाई PQ = 47 सेमी, QR = 39 सेमी, और RP = 41 सेमी है, तो PD की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
PD = PF = X

QD = QE = Y

RE = RF = Z

All are tangents,

PD + PF + QD + QE + RE + RF = PQ + QR + PR

=> X + X + Y + Y + Z + Z = 47 + 39 + 41

=> 2X + 2 (Y + Z) = 127

Y + Z = QE + ER = RQ [RQ = 39 cm]

=> 2X + 2 * 39 = 127

=> 2X = 49

=> X = 24.5 cm

questions.question: A man purchases 50 eggs at Rs.7 per piece and out of total purchased eggs, 40% are broken. If out of total broken eggs, he is able to sell only 60%. He marked up the price of each egg up in such a way that after selling only non-broken eggs he can gain 20% profit. He sold the non-broken eggs at the marked price and broken eggs at 25% discount. What is the total amount of profit earned by the man in overall transaction?
questions.question_hi: एक व्यक्ति रु. 7 प्रति पीस की दर से 50 अंडे खरीदता है और कुल खरीदे गए अंडों में से 40% टूटे हुए हैं। यदि कुल टूटे हुए अंडों में से वह केवल 60% ही बेच पाता है। उसने प्रत्येक अंडे की कीमत में वृद्धि इस प्रकार की कि केवल बिना टूटे अंडे बेचने पर उसे 20% लाभ प्राप्त हो सकता है। उसने बिना टूटे अंडे अंकित मूल्य पर और टूटे हुए अंडे 25% छूट पर बेचे। समग्र लेन-देन में व्यक्ति द्वारा अर्जित लाभ की कुल धनराशि कितनी है?
questions.solution:
Cost price of eggs = 50 * 7 = Rs.350

Total non-broken eggs = 60% of 50 = 30

Marked price of each egg = (120% of 350)/30 = Rs.14

Total number of broken eggs sold = 60% of 20 = 12

Total selling price after selling eggs = (14 * 30) + (75% of 14 * 12) = Rs.546

Total amount of profit earned by the man in overall transaction = 546 - 350 = Rs.196

questions.question: Height and radius of a solid cylinder is in the ratio 5:7 respectively. When its radius is decreased by 20%, then its volume becomes 3942.4 cm3. What is the height of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.question_hi: एक ठोस सिलेंडर की ऊंचाई और त्रिज्या क्रमशः 5:7 के अनुपात में हैं। जब इसकी त्रिज्या को 20% कम किया जाता है, तो इसका आयतन 3942.4 सेमी3 हो जाता है। सिलेंडर की ऊंचाई क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.solution:
Let the height and radius of the cylinder are 5a cm and 7a cm respectively.

New radius of cylinder = (100 - 20)% of 7a = 5.6a cm

New volume of cylinder = π * (radius of cylinder)2 * height of cylinder

3942.4 = 22/7 * (5.6a)2 * 5a

a3 = 8

a = 2

Therefore, height of cylinder = 5a = 5 * 2 = 10 cm

I. Some Roman is not Classic

II. All Roman is Classic

questions.question_hi:

कथन:

कुछ रोमन, प्राचीन हैं

कोई प्राचीन, क्लासिक नहीं है

निष्कर्ष:

I. कुछ रोमन, क्लासिक नहीं हैं

II. सभी रोमन, क्लासिक हैं

III. कुछ क्लासिक, प्राचीन हैं

options.label: A
options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I और II अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: B
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: C
options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II और III अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: D
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष III अनुसरण करता है

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some Roman is Ancient

No Ancient is Classic

Some Roman is not Classic: Some Roman is Ancient. No Ancient is Classic. Thus, the Roman which is Ancient is not Classic. So, conclusion I is true.

All Roman is Classic: As there is no relation between Roman and Classic. So, conclusion II is false.

Some Classic is Ancient: No Ancient is Classic. So, conclusion III is false.

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

In each of the questions below, one statement is given, followed by two conclusions which may or may not follow. From the options below, choose the one that reflects the correct choice of conclusion(s) that follows/follow.

A student committed suicide after failing in three of the five subjects of the current semester.

I. Students may take drastic steps if they fail in majority of the subjects of a given semester.

II. Passing in every subject throughout the course holds importance in deciding the future of students.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रत्येक प्रश्नों में, एक कथन दिए गए हैं और उसके बाद दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जो अनुसरण कर भी सकते हैं और नहीं भी कर सकते है| नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से, उस निष्कर्ष (निष्कर्षों) का चयन करें जो सही चयन को दर्शाता है|

एक विद्यार्थी ने वर्तमान सेमेस्टर के पांच विषयों में से तीन में असफल होने पर आत्महत्या कर ली|

I. यदि वे दिए गये सेमेस्टर के अधिकांश विषयों में असफल हो जाते हैं, तो विद्यार्थी कठोर कदम उठा सकते हैं|

II. पूरे पाठ्यक्रम में प्रत्येक विषय में पास होना विद्यार्थियों के भविष्य को तय करने में महत्वपूर्ण होता है|

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Conclusion I follows: failing 3 out of 5 subjects is a majority, and suicide is a drastic step. the word "may" indicates a possibility directly supported by the incident.

Conclusion II does not follow: the statement gives a single case and does not establish any broad rule about passing every subject to decide a student's future.

So, only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: In a code language: 'M & N' means 'M is father of N'; 'M @ N' means 'M is mother of N'; 'M % N' means 'M is sister of N'; 'M $ N' means 'M is brother of N'. If A @ B & C $ D % E, which of the following is true?
questions.question_hi: एक कूट भाषा में: 'M & N' का अर्थ है 'M, N का पिता है'; 'M @ N' का अर्थ है 'M, N की माता है'; 'M % N' का अर्थ है 'M, N की बहन है'; 'M $ N' का अर्थ है 'M, N का भाई है'। यदि A @ B & C $ D % E है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्य है?

options.label: C
options.text: C is paternal uncle of E

questions.solution:
It is given that,

'M & N' means 'M is father of N';

'M @ N' means 'M is mother of N';

'M % N' means 'M is sister of N';

'M $ N' means 'M is brother of N'.

After decoding, A @ B & C $ D % E, we get:

A@B => A mother of B

B&C => B is father of C

C$D => C is brother of D

D%E => D is sister of E => E is sibling of D

Thus, statement given in option (b) is true.

questions.question: In a particular code language, if OWN is written as NPXYOP and PET is written as QRDFUV in code format, how will CUB be written?

questions.solution:
OWN is written as NPXYOP and PET is written as QRDFUV.

Alphabets ABCDEFGHIJKLM
Values 12345678910111213
Alphabets NOPQRSTUVWXYZ
Values 14151617181920212223242526

Here, the pattern is:

Each vowel is replaced by immediate previous and immediate next alphabet as in the English alphabetical series.

Each consonant is replaced by immediate next and 2nd next alphabet as in the English alphabetical series.

O-1 = N; O+1= P

W+1 = X, X+1= Y

N+1= O, O+1= P

Similarly,

P+1= Q, Q+1= R

E-1= D, E+1= F

T+1= U, U+1= V

Therefore,

C+1= D, D+1= E

U-1= T, U+1= V

B+1= C, C+1= D

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

79 * 24 * 3 * 310 * 5 * 89
questions.solution:
Option (a) If * signs are replaced by ÷, x, - , +, = signs sequentially, then the equation will be: 79 ÷ 24 x 3 - 310 + 5 = 89

So, 3.29 x 3 - 310 + 5 = 89

So, 9.87 - 310 + 5 = 89

So, 14.87 - 310 = 89

So, -295.13 ≠ 89

So, the equation is not balanced.

Option (b) If * signs are replaced by +, ÷, x, - , = signs sequentially, then the equation will be: 79 + 24 ÷ 3 x 310 - 5 = 89

So, 79 + 8 x 310 - 5 = 89

So, 79 + 2480 - 5 = 89

So, 2559 - 5 = 89

So, 2554 ≠ 89

So, the equation is not balanced.

Option (c) If * signs are replaced by ÷, +, x, - , = signs sequentially, then the equation will be: 79 ÷ 24 + 3 x 310 - 5 = 89

So, 3.29 + 3 x 310 - 5 = 89

So, 3.29 + 930 - 5 = 89

So, 3.29 + 930 - 5 = 89

So, 933.29 - 5 = 89

So, 928.29 ≠ 89

So, the equation is not balanced.

Option (d) If * signs are replaced by +, x, - , ÷, = signs sequentially, then the equation will be: 79 + 24 x 3 - 310 ÷ 5 = 89

questions.question: Select the sentence in which the '-ing' form of verb expresses the continuity of an action/event.

options.label: A
options.text: He avoided speaking in public due to nervousness and hesitation.

options.label: B
options.text: I was running through the park when it began to rain.

options.label: C
options.text: Walking briskly every morning keeps her energetic throughout the day.

options.label: D
options.text: Their planning led to a very successful product launch eventually.

questions.correct_text: I was running through the park when it began to rain.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: b) I was running through the park when it began to rain.

In this sentence, "was running" is in the past continuous tense. The "-ing" form "running" is combined with the helping verb "was" to indicate that the action was in progress at the time another event occurred, showing continuity.

In option a), "speaking" is a gerund, functioning as the object of the verb "avoided," not indicating an ongoing action.

In option c), "walking" is also a gerund acting as the subject of the sentence and does not express continuity.

In option d), "planning" functions as a noun and refers to the act in general, not an ongoing event.

Only option b) uses the "-ing" form to express an action that was continuing at a specific moment.

Note: Gerund: Gerund is a verb form that functions as a noun, ending in -ing. A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence in English. Example: "Everybody enjoyed her dancing and singing at the party." The words 'dancing' and 'singing' are gerunds.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

He will punish for his misbehaviour on the field.
questions.solution:
In the given sentence 'punish' is a transitive verb. So, it requires a direct object. The sentence doesn't have a direct object. So, the sentence is grammatically incorrect.

Options (a) and (d) are also eliminated because the verb doesn't have a direct object. Option (c) is in passive voice. So, the object of the verb will be 'he', i.e., the subject of the passive voice 'he' will be the receiver of the action 'punish'. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

Note:

Active and Passive Voice: When the person doing the action is the subject, the sentence is said to be in active form/voice. When the subject is what the action is directed at, then the sentence is said to be in passive form/voice. For example: Active Voice: Rita and her friends performed a skit. Here 'Rita and her friends' (subject) perform the action. Passive Voice: A skit was performed by Rita and her friends. Here 'skit' is the subject (at which the action is directed).

Transitive and intransitive verbs: Some verbs always need an object (a noun, phrase, or pronoun that refers to the person or thing that is affected by the action of the verb). These are called transitive verbs. Some verbs never have an object. These are called intransitive verbs. Examples: 1. Transitive verb: "Do you believe in miracles"; the boldened part is the transitive verb and underlined part is the object. 2. Intransitive verb: "It was snowing heavily."; here 'snowing' is the intransitive verb (contains no object).

questions.question:

options.label: A
options.text: and invested a portion of my salary

options.label: B
options.text: and this investment gave me a huge benefit in the long run.

questions.solution:
In the case of Hyphenated words, only the last word shows possession. Thus, we should add apostrophe to the last word only. This form of a noun is called a possessive form.

For example: My mother-in-law's car.

In the question, the use of the apostrophe in "father's- in- law" is incorrect. Instead, "father-in-law's" should be the appropriate usage in part (d) of the sentence.

Thus, the error is in option (d) - I took my father's-in-law advice.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: I took my father-in-law's advice and invested a portion of my salary in mutual funds and this investment gave me a huge benefit in the long run.

Additional Information:

A possessive form is a word or grammatical construction used to indicate a relationship of possession in a broad sense. This can include strict ownership or several other types of relationships to a greater or lesser degree analogous to it.

When possessive nouns are joined together, we add an apostrophe to the last name only.

For example: Ronaldo and Messi's record.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

John said to me, "Michael hasn't bothered to point out these issues for your family."

questions.correct_text: John told me that Michael hadn't bothered to point out those issues for my family.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Present Perfect Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Perfect Tense.

Present Perfect (Subject + has/have + V3 +Object) should be converted into Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object).

For example:

He said, "I have got a new job." (Direct Speech)

He said that he had got a new job. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'told'.

· The verb 'hasn't bothered' (present perfect) is changed into 'hadn't bothered' (past perfect).

· The possessive determiner 'your' is changed into 'my'.

· 'These issues' is changed into 'those issues'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d): John told me that Michael hadn't bothered to point out those issues for my family.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The team leader suggested to his colleagues that they should take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project.

options.label: A
options.text: The team leader said to his colleagues, "Let us take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."

options.label: B
options.text: The team leader told his colleagues, "We should take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."

options.label: C
options.text: The team leader suggested, "Let's take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."

options.label: D
options.text: The team leader said to his colleagues, "You should take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."

questions.correct_text: The team leader said to his colleagues, "Let us take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."
questions.solution:
When "Let" is used as a proposal/suggestion, certain rules are followed for conversion. "suggested/suggested to" is changed to "said/said to". The conjunction 'that' is removed, and 'Let' is added in the direct speech. The modal verb 'should' is removed.

Example 1:

He suggested that they should go to the amusement park. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "Let us go to the amusement park". (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

· 'Suggested to' is changed into 'said to'.

· The structure 'that they should take' is replaced by 'Let us take'.

· Inverted commas ("..") are placed around the direct suggestion.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The team leader said to his colleagues, "Let us take a short break before starting the next phase of the critical project."

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The report is to be written by you. The presentation is also to be prepared by you.

options.label: A
options.text: You are writing the report. You are also preparing the presentation.

options.label: B
options.text: You are to write the report. You are also to prepare the presentation.

options.label: C
options.text: You are to write the report. You are also to preparing the presentation.

options.label: D
options.text: You are about to write the report. You are also about to prepare the presentation.

questions.correct_text: You are to write the report. You are also to prepare the presentation.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb [here 'be'] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In Active voice, the sentence should be in Infinitive form (to + V1).

The format in Passive voice is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are/was/were + to + be + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format in Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are/was/were + to + V1 + Object.

For example:

She is to be helped by you. (Passive)

You are to help her (Active)

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: You are to write the report. You are also to prepare the presentation.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

Arrange the following sentences in the most logical sequence.

1) As a result, productivity initially declined in many sectors.

2) The sudden transition to remote work caught many companies unprepared.

3) Over time, organizations adapted by adopting better tools and workflows.

4) Employees struggled with communication gaps and lack of proper infrastructure.

5) However, this period also encouraged innovation in workplace practices.
questions.solution:
The passage begins with 2, which introduces the central situation the sudden shift to remote work and lack of preparedness among companies. Sentence 4 logically follows, as it elaborates on the immediate challenges faced by employees, such as communication gaps and inadequate infrastructure.

Sentence 1 comes next, beginning with "As a result," which indicates the consequence of these challenges decline in productivity. Sentence 5 introduces a contrast with "However," signaling a shift in perspective by highlighting a positive outcome - innovation in workplace practices.

Finally, sentence 3 concludes the passage, as "Over time" indicates progression and shows how organizations adapted by improving tools and workflows.

Thus, the correct sequence is 2-4-1-5-3. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The 2026 Wimbledon Championships was the 139th edition of the Wimbledon Championships, a major tennis tournament, which took place at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in Wimbledon, London, England from 29 June to 12 July 2026, with the qualifying rounds taking place between 22 to 25 June 2026. For the first time in the Wimbledon championships history, matches had video reviews. Initially, players would only be allowed to challenge certain calls made by the chair umpires on matches at the Centre Court and No. 1 Court and on the other four show courts when they were hosting singles matches (No. 2 Court, No. 3 Court, No. 12 Court and No. 18 Court). The event formed part of Wimbledon's annual outreach activities in the United States, following the ''The Hill in New York'' event, which has been staged annually since 2022. For the first time, the venue was transformed into a temporary grass court constructed and maintained by Wimbledon's groundstaff. The centerpiece of the event was ''The Wimbledon Court Invitational'', an exhibition doubles match featuring former professional players and tennis personalities, which was held on 26 June.

On 27 and 28 June, members of the public were given the opportunity to play on the grass court through a ballot system. The event concluded with a public screening of the opening day's play from the 2026 Wimbledon Championships, broadcast live on giant screens in Central Park. The title Unto This Last comes from the biblical parable of the labourers in the vineyard, in which workers who arrive at different times receive the same payment. Ruskin uses this idea to question conventional notions of economic value and to argue that human worth should not be measured simply by productivity or financial gain. The work ultimately presents an ethical vision of economics in which the well-being of every member of society deserves consideration.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands:

1) The Ramsar Convention is an intergovernmental treaty adopted in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran, and it is the only global environmental treaty that focuses on a specific ecosystem - wetlands.

2) A wetland designated under the Ramsar Convention is called a Ramsar Site - once designated, the concerned country is legally bound to restore the wetland to its original state if it deteriorates, failing which the site is automatically delisted.

3) India currently has the highest number of Ramsar Sites in Asia, and Chilika Lake in Odisha was one of the first two Ramsar Sites designated in India in 1981.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
आर्द्रभूमियों पर रामसर कन्वेंशन के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) रामसर कन्वेंशन 1971 में रामसर, ईरान में अपनाया गया एक अंतर-सरकारी समझौता है, और यह एकमात्र वैश्विक पर्यावरण समझौता है जो एक विशिष्ट पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र - आर्द्रभूमि पर केंद्रित है।

2) रामसर कन्वेंशन के तहत नामित आर्द्रभूमि को रामसर साइट कहा जाता है - एक बार नामित होने के बाद, संबंधित देश कानूनी रूप से आर्द्रभूमि के बिगड़ने पर उसे उसकी मूल स्थिति में बहाल करने के लिए बाध्य है, ऐसा न करने पर साइट स्वचालित रूप से सूची से हटा दी जाती है।

3) वर्तमान में एशिया में भारत में रामसर साइटों की संख्या सबसे अधिक है, और ओडिशा में चिल्का झील 1981 में भारत में नामित पहली दो रामसर साइटों में से एक थी।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Ramsar Convention was adopted on 2 February 1971 - this date is now celebrated annually as World Wetlands Day. It is indeed ecosystem-specific, focusing entirely on wetlands, making it unique among global environmental treaties.

Statement 2 is incorrect: While Ramsar designation does obligate countries to promote conservation and wise use of listed wetlands, there is no automatic delisting mechanism nor a legal obligation to restore deteriorated sites under penalty. Countries submit monitoring reports and the Ramsar Secretariat can place a site on the Montreux Record (a list of Ramsar Sites facing ecological change) - but this is an advisory tool, not a punitive one. The Convention works on the principle of wise use and cooperation, not binding enforcement.

Statement 3 is correct: As of July 2026, India has 100 designated Ramsar Sites, which cover a massive 1,387,612 hectares across 28 states and union territories. India has the highest number of Ramsar Sites in Asia and ranks third globally after the United Kingdom and Mexico. Chilika Lake (Odisha) and Keoladeo Ghana National Park (Rajasthan) were India's first two Ramsar designations, both in 1981.

Further insights:

The Montreux Record is a register maintained under the Ramsar Convention of wetland sites facing serious ecological threats such as pollution, urban encroachment, or hydrological changes. India's Loktak Lake (Manipur) and Keoladeo National Park (Rajasthan) have previously appeared on the Montreux Record - Keoladeo was later removed after conditions improved, demonstrating that listing can prompt corrective action even without binding legal enforcement.

अधिक जानकारी:

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the national income aggregates and accounting methodology in India:

I. Net National Product at factor cost (NNPFC) represents the true measure of National Income in macroeconomic accounting.

II. Gross National Product at market prices (GNPMP) is obtained by adding Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA) to Gross Domestic Product at market prices (GDPMP).

III. Personal Income includes undistributed corporate profits and corporate tax payments while strictly excluding government transfer payments.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय समुच्चयों और लेखांकन कार्यप्रणाली के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

I. साधन लागत पर शुद्ध राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (NNPFC) समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र लेखांकन में राष्ट्रीय आय की सही माप का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

II. बाजार कीमतों पर सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNPMP), बाजार कीमतों पर सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDPMP) में विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध कारक आय (NFIA) को जोड़कर प्राप्त किया जाता है।

III. वैयक्तिक आय में अवितरित कॉर्पोरेट लाभ और कॉर्पोरेट कर भुगतान शामिल होते हैं जबकि सरकारी हस्तांतरण भुगतान को पूर्णतः बाहर रखा जाता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

In the traditional national income accounting framework, National Income is represented by Net National Product at factor cost (NNPFC). It measures the net factor income earned by the normal residents of a country during an accounting year. It is obtained after accounting for depreciation and converting national product from market prices to factor cost.

Statement II is correct.

Gross National Product at market prices includes the production-related income attributable to the normal residents of a country, whether earned domestically or from abroad. Therefore, Net Factor Income from Abroad is added to GDP at market prices to obtain GNP at market prices. The relationship can be expressed as GNPMP = GDPMP + NFIA.

Statement III is incorrect.

Personal Income refers to income actually received by individuals from different sources, including relevant current transfer payments and factor incomes. Corporate profit tax and undistributed or retained corporate profits are not received by households and are therefore excluded while deriving Personal Income. Hence, the statement reverses the actual treatment of these components.

Hindi:

कथन I सही है।

पारंपरिक राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन ढांचे में, राष्ट्रीय आय को साधन लागत पर शुद्ध राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (NNPFC) द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है। यह एक लेखा वर्ष के दौरान किसी देश के सामान्य निवासियों द्वारा अर्जित शुद्ध कारक आय को मापता है। यह मूल्यह्रास का लेखांकन करने और राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद को बाजार कीमतों से साधन लागत में परिवर्तित करने के बाद प्राप्त किया जाता है।

कथन II सही है।

बाजार कीमतों पर सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद में किसी देश के सामान्य निवासियों से संबंधित उत्पादन-संबंधी आय शामिल होती है, चाहे वह घरेलू स्तर पर अर्जित की गई हो या विदेशों से। इसलिए, बाजार कीमतों पर GNP प्राप्त करने के लिए बाजार कीमतों पर GDP में विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध कारक आय को जोड़ा जाता है। इस संबंध को GNPMP = GDPMP + NFIA के रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

कथन III गलत है।

वैयक्तिक आय से तात्पर्य व्यक्तियों द्वारा विभिन्न स्रोतों से वास्तव में प्राप्त आय से है, जिसमें प्रासंगिक चालू हस्तांतरण भुगतान और कारक आय शामिल हैं। कॉर्पोरेट लाभ कर और अवितरित या प्रतिधारित कॉर्पोरेट लाभ परिवारों द्वारा प्राप्त नहीं किए जाते हैं और इसलिए वैयक्तिक आय प्राप्त करते समय इन्हें बाहर रखा जाता है। अतः, यह कथन इन घटकों के वास्तविक व्यवहार को उलट देता है।

questions.question: In basketball, which of the following situations would result in a team being awarded a technical foul?
questions.question_hi: बास्केटबॉल में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी स्थिति में एक टीम को तकनीकी फाउल दिया जाएगा?

options.label: A
options.text: A player takes three steps without dribbling after receiving a pass.
options.text_hi: एक खिलाड़ी पास प्राप्त करने के बाद बिना ड्रिब्लिंग के तीन कदम चलता है।

options.label: B
options.text: A coach enters the court without permission from the referee to argue a call.
options.text_hi: कोच बिना रेफरी की अनुमति के कोर्ट में प्रवेश करता है ताकि कॉल पर बहस कर सके।

options.label: C
options.text: A defender makes contact with an offensive player who is in the act of shooting.
options.text_hi: एक रक्षक उस आक्रामक खिलाड़ी के साथ संपर्क करता है जो शॉट लगाने की क्रिया में है।

options.label: D
options.text: An offensive player charges into a stationary defender who has established position.
options.text_hi: एक आक्रामक खिलाड़ी एक स्थिर रक्षक में टकराता है जिसने स्थिति स्थापित कर ली है।

questions.correct_text: A coach enters the court without permission from the referee to argue a call.
questions.solution:
Why B is correct: A technical foul in basketball is an infraction that does not involve physical contact between players on the court during play. Instead, it focuses on unsportsmanlike conduct, procedural violations, or behavioral infractions.

A coach entering the court without permission to argue a referee's decision is a direct violation of bench decorum and sportsmanship rules, resulting in an immediate technical foul. Other examples include using profanity, shattering the backboard, or a player hanging on the rim unnecessarily.

Why the other options are incorrect:

A is incorrect: A player taking three steps without dribbling is a traveling violation, not a foul. It results in a turnover, and the opposing team is awarded a simple throw-in from the sideline.

C is incorrect: Contact made by a defender on a shooting offensive player is a standard personal foul (specifically, a shooting foul). It results in the offensive player being awarded two or three free throws, depending on where the shot was taken.

D is incorrect: An offensive player running into a stationary defender who has established legal marketing position is an offensive foul (commonly known as a charging foul). It is a personal foul that results in a turnover.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the types and physiological functions of plant meristematic tissues:

I. The apical meristem is situated at the growing tips of stems and roots and is primarily responsible for the increase in length of the plant.

II. The lateral meristem (cambium) facilitates the secondary growth and is responsible for the increase in the girth or diameter of the stem and root.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पादप विभज्योतक (meristematic) ऊतकों के प्रकारों और शारीरिक कार्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. शीर्षस्थ विभज्योतक (apical meristem) तनों और जड़ों के बढ़ते सिरों पर स्थित होता है और मुख्य रूप से पौधे की लंबाई में वृद्धि के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है।

II. पार्श्व विभज्योतक (lateral meristem - कैम्बियम) द्वितीयक वृद्धि को सुगम बनाता है और तने तथा जड़ की मोटाई या व्यास में वृद्धि के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct:

The apical meristem is present at the growing tips of roots and shoots. Its actively dividing cells continuously produce new cells that contribute to the elongation of these plant parts. This type of growth is known as primary growth and mainly increases the length of the plant.

Statement II is correct:

The lateral meristem occurs along the sides of stems and roots and includes tissues such as vascular cambium and cork cambium. Its cell divisions contribute to secondary growth, which increases the thickness or diameter of plant organs. It is particularly important in the growth of woody stems and roots.

Further Insights:

- Meristematic tissues consist of cells that retain the capacity to divide actively throughout the life of the plant.

- Intercalary meristems occur between mature tissues, particularly near the bases of leaves or internodes in certain plants.

- Primary growth produces the primary plant body and is mainly associated with apical meristems.

- Vascular cambium produces secondary vascular tissues during secondary growth.

- Cork cambium contributes to the formation of protective tissues that replace the epidermis during secondary growth.

Hindi:

कथन I सही है:

शीर्षस्थ विभज्योतक जड़ों और प्ररोहों (shoots) के बढ़ते सिरों पर मौजूद होता है। इसकी सक्रिय रूप से विभाजित होने वाली कोशिकाएं लगातार नई कोशिकाओं का निर्माण करती हैं जो पौधे के इन भागों के विस्तार (elongation) में योगदान करती हैं। इस प्रकार की वृद्धि को प्राथमिक वृद्धि के रूप में जाना जाता है और यह मुख्य रूप से पौधे की लंबाई बढ़ाती है।

कथन II सही है:

पार्श्व विभज्योतक तनों और जड़ों के किनारों के साथ पाया जाता है और इसमें संवहनी कैम्बियम (vascular cambium) और कॉर्क कैम्बियम (cork cambium) जैसे ऊतक शामिल होते हैं। इसके कोशिका विभाजन द्वितीयक वृद्धि में योगदान करते हैं, जिससे पौधे के अंगों की मोटाई या व्यास बढ़ता है। यह विशेष रूप से लकड़ी वाले तनों और जड़ों की वृद्धि में महत्वपूर्ण है।

अन्य तथ्य (Further Insights):

- विभज्योतक ऊतकों में ऐसी कोशिकाएं होती हैं जो पौधे के पूरे जीवनकाल में सक्रिय रूप से विभाजित होने की क्षमता बनाए रखती हैं।

- अंतर्वेशी विभज्योतक (Intercalary meristems) परिपक्व ऊतकों के बीच, विशेष रूप से कुछ पौधों में पत्तियों या पोरियों (internodes) के आधार के पास पाए जाते हैं।

- प्राथमिक वृद्धि प्राथमिक पादप शरीर का निर्माण करती है और मुख्य रूप से शीर्षस्थ विभज्योतकों से जुड़ी होती है।

- संवहनी कैम्बियम द्वितीयक वृद्धि के दौरान द्वितीयक संवहनी ऊतकों का निर्माण करता है।

- कॉर्क कैम्बियम सुरक्षात्मक ऊतकों के निर्माण में योगदान देता है जो द्वितीयक वृद्धि के दौरान एपिडर्मिस (बाह्यत्वचा) को प्रतिस्थापित करते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Electricity and Circuits:

1) Ohm's Law states that the current (I) flowing through a conductor is directly proportional to the voltage (V) across it, provided the temperature and physical conditions remain constant - expressed as V = IR, where R is resistance.

2) When resistors are connected in series, the total resistance is the sum of individual resistances, and the same current flows through all resistors - but the voltage is divided across them.

3) When resistors are connected in parallel, the total resistance is greater than the largest individual resistance, and the voltage across each resistor is the same - but current is divided.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विद्युत और परिपथ (Electricity and Circuits) के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) ओम का नियम बताता है कि किसी चालक से प्रवाहित होने वाली धारा (I) उसके सिरों पर वोल्टेज (V) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है, बशर्ते तापमान और भौतिक स्थितियाँ स्थिर रहें - इसे V = IR के रूप में व्यक्त किया जाता है, जहाँ R प्रतिरोध है।

2) जब प्रतिरोधकों को श्रेणीक्रम (series) में जोड़ा जाता है, तो कुल प्रतिरोध व्यक्तिगत प्रतिरोधों का योग होता है, और सभी प्रतिरोधकों से समान धारा प्रवाहित होती है - लेकिन वोल्टेज उनके बीच विभाजित हो जाता है।

3) जब प्रतिरोधकों को समानांतर (parallel) में जोड़ा जाता है, तो कुल प्रतिरोध सबसे बड़े व्यक्तिगत प्रतिरोध से अधिक होता है, और प्रत्येक प्रतिरोधक पर वोल्टेज समान होता है - लेकिन धारा विभाजित हो जाती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Ohm's Law (Georg Simon Ohm, 1827): V = IR. The condition "constant temperature" is crucial - resistance of most conductors increases with temperature, so at high temperatures Ohm's Law may not hold (non-ohmic conductors).

Statement 2 is correct: Series: R_total = R1 + R2 + R3. Same current through all, voltage divided. If one component fails (open circuit), the entire circuit breaks - why old Christmas lights all went dark when one bulb failed.

Statement 3 is incorrect: In a parallel circuit, the total resistance is less than the smallest individual resistance (1/R_total = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ...). This is why adding more parallel branches reduces overall resistance and increases total current. Household wiring uses parallel connections so devices operate at the same voltage independently.

Further insights:

Electric Power = V X I = I2R = V2/R. This is why high-voltage transmission lines are used for long-distance power transfer - for the same power, higher voltage means lower current, and since heat loss = I2R, lower current dramatically reduces transmission losses.

Hindi:

कथन 1 सही है: ओम का नियम (जॉर्ज साइमन ओम, 1827): V = IR। "स्थिर तापमान" की शर्त महत्वपूर्ण है - अधिकांश चालकों का प्रतिरोध तापमान के साथ बढ़ता है, इसलिए उच्च तापमान पर ओम का नियम लागू नहीं हो सकता है (अन-ओमीय चालक)।

कथन 2 सही है: श्रेणीक्रम: R_total = R1 + R2 + R3। सभी से समान धारा प्रवाहित होती है, वोल्टेज विभाजित होता है। यदि एक घटक विफल हो जाता है (खुला परिपथ), तो पूरा परिपथ टूट जाता है - यही कारण है कि पुरानी क्रिसमस लाइटों में एक बल्ब के खराब होने पर सभी लाइटें बंद हो जाती थीं।

कथन 3 गलत है: एक समानांतर परिपथ में, कुल प्रतिरोध सबसे छोटे व्यक्तिगत प्रतिरोध से कम होता है (1/R_total = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ...)। यही कारण है कि अधिक समानांतर शाखाएं जोड़ने से समग्र प्रतिरोध कम हो जाता है और कुल धारा बढ़ जाती है। घरेलू वायरिंग में समानांतर कनेक्शन का उपयोग किया जाता है ताकि उपकरण स्वतंत्र रूप से समान वोल्टेज पर काम कर सकें।

अधिक जानकारी:

विद्युत शक्ति (Electric Power) = V X I = I2R = V2/R। यही कारण है कि लंबी दूरी के बिजली हस्तांतरण के लिए उच्च-वोल्टेज ट्रांसमिशन लाइनों का उपयोग किया जाता है - समान शक्ति के लिए, उच्च वोल्टेज का अर्थ है कम धारा, और चूंकि ऊष्मा हानि = I2R, कम धारा ट्रांसमिशन हानियों को नाटकीय रूप से कम कर देती है।

questions.question:
With reference to rural human settlement patterns, consider the following statements:

i) Compact settlements consist of closely built-up areas where houses are located near one another.

ii) Dispersed settlements consist of isolated huts or houses scattered over a relatively large area, often occurring in remote or difficult terrain.

iii) Linear settlements develop when houses are arranged along features such as roads, rivers, canals or railway tracks.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ग्रामीण मानव बस्ती प्रतिरूपों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) सघन बस्तियों में पास-पास निर्मित क्षेत्र होते हैं जहाँ घर एक-दूसरे के निकट स्थित होते हैं।

ii) प्रकीर्ण (बिखरी हुई) बस्तियों में अपेक्षाकृत बड़े क्षेत्र में बिखरी हुई अलग-थलग झोपड़ियाँ या घर होते हैं, जो अक्सर दूरदराज या दुर्गम इलाकों में पाए जाते हैं।

iii) रैखिक बस्तियाँ तब विकसित होती हैं जब घरों को सड़कों, नदियों, नहरों या रेलवे पटरियों जैसी विशेषताओं के साथ व्यवस्थित किया जाता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Option 4, i, ii and iii, is correct because all three statements accurately describe major patterns of rural settlements.

Statement i is correct

In a compact or clustered settlement, houses are located close to each other, forming a relatively concentrated settlement.

Statement ii is correct

Dispersed settlements have houses or huts scattered over a wider area rather than concentrated in one place. Such settlements are commonly associated with areas where physical conditions make close clustering difficult.

Statement iii is correct

Linear settlements develop in a line along important physical or transport features such as roads, rivers, canals and railway tracks.

Hindi:

विकल्प 4, i, ii और iii, सही है क्योंकि तीनों कथन ग्रामीण बस्तियों के प्रमुख प्रतिरूपों का सटीक वर्णन करते हैं।

कथन i सही है

एक सघन या गुच्छित बस्ती में, घर एक-दूसरे के करीब स्थित होते हैं, जिससे एक अपेक्षाकृत संकेंद्रित बस्ती बनती है।

कथन ii सही है

प्रकीर्ण बस्तियों में घर या झोपड़ियाँ एक स्थान पर केंद्रित होने के बजाय एक विस्तृत क्षेत्र में बिखरे होते हैं। ऐसी बस्तियाँ आमतौर पर उन क्षेत्रों से जुड़ी होती हैं जहाँ भौतिक स्थितियाँ सघन गुच्छन को कठिन बना देती हैं।

कथन iii सही है

रैखिक बस्तियाँ महत्वपूर्ण भौतिक या परिवहन विशेषताओं जैसे सड़कों, नदियों, नहरों और रेलवे पटरियों के साथ एक रेखा में विकसित होती हैं।

सूची-I (RBI मौद्रिक नीति उपकरण) को सूची-II (प्रमुख परिचालन विशेषता) के साथ सुमेलित करें:

A. नीतिगत रेपो दर1. LAF कॉरिडोर के आधार (फ्लोर) के रूप में कार्य करने वाली संपार्श्विक-मुक्त अवशोषण सुविधा
B. स्थायी जमा सुविधा (SDF)2. आपातकालीन उधार विंडो जो बैंकों को उनके SLR कोटे का उपयोग करने की अनुमति देती है
C. सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा (MSF)3. सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों के एवज में अल्पकालिक तरलता डालने के लिए बेंचमार्क उधार दर
D. निश्चित रिवर्स रेपो दर4. सक्रिय परिचालन कॉरिडोर के बाहर रखा गया विवेकाधीन संपार्श्विक उपकरण
questions.solution:
A-3: Policy Repo Rate

The policy repo rate is the rate at which the RBI provides short-term liquidity to banks against eligible government and other approved securities. It is the key policy rate decided by the Monetary Policy Committee and lies at the centre of the current LAF(Liquidity Adjustment Facility) corridor.

B-1: Standing Deposit Facility (SDF)

The SDF enables the RBI to absorb liquidity from banks without requiring the RBI to provide collateral in return. Introduced in April 2022, it replaced the fixed reverse repo rate as the floor of the LAF corridor. The SDF rate is placed below the policy repo rate and functions as a standing absorption facility.

C-2: Marginal Standing Facility (MSF)

The MSF is an overnight borrowing facility available to scheduled commercial banks when they face unexpected liquidity shortages. Banks can borrow from the RBI against eligible securities and can dip into their SLR holdings up to the prescribed limit. It therefore acts as a safety valve against unforeseen liquidity shocks.

D-4: Fixed Reverse Repo Rate

After the introduction of the SDF, the fixed reverse repo rate ceased to be the floor of the LAF corridor. However, the RBI retained the fixed rate reverse repo as part of its liquidity-management toolkit, with its operation being at the RBI's discretion for specified purposes.

Hindi:

A-3: नीतिगत रेपो दर

नीतिगत रेपो दर वह दर है जिस पर RBI पात्र सरकारी और अन्य अनुमोदित प्रतिभूतियों के एवज में बैंकों को अल्पकालिक तरलता प्रदान करता है। यह मौद्रिक नीति समिति द्वारा तय की गई प्रमुख नीतिगत दर है और वर्तमान LAF (तरलता समायोजन सुविधा) कॉरिडोर के केंद्र में स्थित है।

B-1: स्थायी जमा सुविधा (SDF)

SDF, RBI को बदले में संपार्श्विक प्रदान करने की आवश्यकता के बिना बैंकों से तरलता को अवशोषित करने में सक्षम बनाता है। अप्रैल 2022 में पेश किया गया, इसने LAF कॉरिडोर के आधार (फ्लोर) के रूप में निश्चित रिवर्स रेपो दर को प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया। SDF दर को नीतिगत रेपो दर से नीचे रखा गया है और यह एक स्थायी अवशोषण सुविधा के रूप में कार्य करता है।

C-2: सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा (MSF)

MSF अनुसूचित वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के लिए उपलब्ध एक ओवरनाइट उधार सुविधा है जब उन्हें अप्रत्याशित तरलता की कमी का सामना करना पड़ता है। बैंक पात्र प्रतिभूतियों के एवज में RBI से उधार ले सकते हैं और निर्धारित सीमा तक अपनी SLR होल्डिंग्स का उपयोग कर सकते हैं। इसलिए यह अप्रत्याशित तरलता झटके के खिलाफ एक सुरक्षा वाल्व के रूप में कार्य करता है।

D-4: निश्चित रिवर्स रेपो दर

SDF की शुरुआत के बाद, निश्चित रिवर्स रेपो दर LAF कॉरिडोर का आधार (फ्लोर) नहीं रही। हालाँकि, RBI ने अपने तरलता-प्रबंधन टूलकिट के हिस्से के रूप में निश्चित दर रिवर्स रेपो को बरकरार रखा, जिसका संचालन निर्दिष्ट उद्देश्यों के लिए RBI के विवेक पर है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the archaeological site of Harappa:

Statement I: Harappa was excavated in 1921 - 22 by Daya Ram Sahni and was situated along the Ravi River.

Statement II: Harappa was uniquely divided into three principal sections known as the Citadel, Middle Town and Lower Town.

Statement III: Archaeological evidence associated with Harappa includes a granary complex and workmen's quarters, while the wider Harappan civilisation procured copper from the Khetri region of present-day Rajasthan.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
हड़प्पा के पुरातात्विक स्थल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: हड़प्पा की खुदाई 1921-22 में दया राम साहनी द्वारा की गई थी और यह रावी नदी के किनारे स्थित था।

कथन II: हड़प्पा को विशिष्ट रूप से तीन मुख्य खंडों में विभाजित किया गया था जिन्हें गढ़ (सिटाडेल), मध्य नगर और निचला नगर कहा जाता था।

कथन III: हड़प्पा से जुड़े पुरातात्विक साक्ष्यों में एक अन्नागार परिसर और श्रमिकों के आवास शामिल हैं, जबकि व्यापक हड़प्पा सभ्यता ने वर्तमान राजस्थान के खेतड़ी क्षेत्र से तांबा प्राप्त किया था।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Statement I and Statement II
options.text_hi: केवल कथन I और कथन II

options.label: B
options.text: Only Statement II and Statement III
options.text_hi: केवल कथन II और कथन III

options.label: C
options.text: Only Statement I and Statement III
options.text_hi: केवल कथन I और कथन III

options.label: D
options.text: Statement I, Statement II and Statement III
options.text_hi: कथन I, कथन II और कथन III

questions.correct_text: Only Statement I and Statement III
questions.solution:
Only Statement I and Statement III are correct.

Statement I is correct

Archaeological excavations at Harappa were undertaken by Daya Ram Sahni in 1921 - 22.

The site of Harappa was located on the banks of the Ravi River in the Punjab region, now in Pakistan.

Statement III is correct

A major granary complex and workmen's quarters are associated with Harappa.

Workmen's quarters were located near the granary at Harappa.

The Harappans may have sent expeditions to the Khetri region of Rajasthan to procure copper.

Statement II is incorrect

The three-part division into the Citadel, Middle Town and Lower Town is a distinctive feature associated with Dholavira rather than Harappa.

Further insights:

- Harappa was the first site of the civilisation to be discovered, giving the Harappan Civilisation its name.

- Rakhigarhi, Mohenjodaro, Harappa, Dholavira and Ganweriwala are among the major Harappan cities.

- Dholavira is distinguished by its three-part urban division and sophisticated water-management system.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding recent developments in India's Space Programs:

1. High-resolution radar imagery can be obtained through MiniSAR (Miniaturized Synthetic Aperture Radar) systems operating at X-band frequencies.

2. Synthetic Aperture Radar allows for land imaging during both day and night, and can penetrate cloud cover.

3. Chandrayaan missions utilize ground-penetrating radar instruments to measure the depths of regolith layers and detect sub-surface crater formations on the moon.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के अंतरिक्ष कार्यक्रमों में हाल के विकास के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. उच्च-रिज़ॉल्यूशन रडार छवियां मिनीएसएआर (मिनीचुराइज्ड सिंथेटिक एपर्चर रडार) सिस्टम के माध्यम से प्राप्त की जा सकती हैं जो एक्स-बैंड आवृत्तियों पर कार्य करते हैं।

2. सिंथेटिक एपर्चर रडार दिन और रात दोनों में भूमि की छवि बनाने की अनुमति देता है, और बादल के आवरण को पार कर सकता है।

3. चंद्रयान मिशन चंद्रमा पर रेगोलिथ परतों की गहराई मापने और सतह के नीचे क्रेटर संरचनाओं का पता लगाने के लिए ग्राउंड-पेनेट्रेटिंग रडार उपकरणों का उपयोग करते हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Miniaturized SAR systems on airborne or small satellite platforms use shorter X-band wavelengths to capture detailed surface imagery.

Statement 2 is correct: SAR systems emit their own radar signals, enabling them to collect data regardless of sunlight or weather conditions.

Statement 3 is correct: Instruments like the Dual Frequency SAR on Chandrayaan-2 and subsurface radar tools help map the moon's surface layers and identify buried structures.

Further insights:

These radar technologies provide valuable data for resource mapping, terrain analysis, and planetary science.

questions.question: Under the new criminal procedure framework in India, what is the primary defining feature of a Zero FIR?
questions.question_hi: भारत में नई आपराधिक प्रक्रिया रूपरेखा के तहत, जीरो एफआईआर (Zero FIR) की प्राथमिक परिभाषित विशेषता क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: It applies exclusively to non-cognizable civil and domestic disputes
options.text_hi: यह विशेष रूप से गैर-संज्ञेय नागरिक और घरेलू विवादों पर लागू होती है

options.label: B
options.text: It can only be initiated upon a direct written order issued by a Judicial Magistrate
options.text_hi: इसे केवल न्यायिक मजिस्ट्रेट द्वारा जारी प्रत्यक्ष लिखित आदेश पर ही शुरू किया जा सकता है

options.label: C
options.text: It can be registered at any police station irrespective of territorial jurisdiction
options.text_hi: इसे क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र की परवाह किए बिना किसी भी पुलिस स्टेशन में दर्ज किया जा सकता है

options.label: D
options.text: It is restricted to offences committed within designated high-security border zones
options.text_hi: यह निर्दिष्ट उच्च-सुरक्षा सीमा क्षेत्रों के भीतर किए गए अपराधों तक सीमित है

questions.correct_text: It can be registered at any police station irrespective of territorial jurisdiction
questions.solution:
A Zero First Information Report can be registered at any police station irrespective of the territorial jurisdiction in which the offence occurred. Under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, information relating to a cognizable offence may be given to the officer in charge of a police station irrespective of the area where the offence was committed. This enables prompt registration instead of requiring the informant to first locate the police station having territorial jurisdiction.

Further Insights:

- The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 as India's principal criminal procedure law.

- The new criminal laws came into force across India on 1 July 2024.

- Information regarding a cognizable offence may also be communicated electronically under the new framework.

Hindi:

एक जीरो फर्स्ट इंफॉर्मेशन रिपोर्ट (Zero FIR) किसी भी पुलिस स्टेशन में दर्ज की जा सकती है, चाहे अपराध किसी भी क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र में हुआ हो। भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता, 2023 के तहत, किसी संज्ञेय अपराध से संबंधित जानकारी किसी पुलिस स्टेशन के प्रभारी अधिकारी को दी जा सकती है, चाहे अपराध किसी भी क्षेत्र में किया गया हो। यह सूचना देने वाले को पहले क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र वाले पुलिस स्टेशन का पता लगाने की आवश्यकता के बजाय त्वरित पंजीकरण में सक्षम बनाता है।

अधिक जानकारी:

- भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता, 2023 ने भारत के प्रमुख आपराधिक प्रक्रिया कानून के रूप में दंड प्रक्रिया संहिता, 1973 का स्थान लिया।

- नए ढांचे के तहत संज्ञेय अपराध के संबंध में जानकारी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप से भी संप्रेषित की जा सकती है।

questions.question: The Jaduguda mine, which was the first commercial underground uranium mine developed in India, is located in which state?
questions.question_hi: जादूगोड़ा खदान, जो भारत में विकसित पहली व्यावसायिक भूमिगत यूरेनियम खदान थी, किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.solution:
The Jaduguda uranium mine is located in the East Singhbhum district of Jharkhand. It was the first mine in India to produce uranium ore on a commercial scale and was commissioned in 1967. The mine is operated by the Uranium Corporation of India Limited under the Department of Atomic Energy.

Further Insights:

- Uranium Corporation of India Limited was incorporated on 4 October 1967 as a public sector enterprise under the Department of Atomic Energy.

- Jaduguda uses underground mining and is accessed through a vertical shaft.

- Bhatin, Narwapahar, Turamdih, Bagjata and Mohuldih are other underground uranium mines operated in Jharkhand.

- Banduhurang in Jharkhand is distinguished as India's first open-pit uranium mine.

- Uranium ore from mines in the Jaduguda region is processed for use in India's nuclear power programme.

Hindi:

जादूगोड़ा यूरेनियम खदान झारखंड के पूर्वी सिंहभूम जिले में स्थित है। यह व्यावसायिक पैमाने पर यूरेनियम अयस्क का उत्पादन करने वाली भारत की पहली खदान थी और इसे 1967 में चालू किया गया था। खदान का संचालन परमाणु ऊर्जा विभाग के तहत यूरेनियम कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड द्वारा किया जाता है।

अधिक जानकारी:

- यूरेनियम कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड को 4 अक्टूबर 1967 को परमाणु ऊर्जा विभाग के तहत एक सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उद्यम के रूप में निगमित किया गया था।

- जादूगोड़ा भूमिगत खनन का उपयोग करता है और एक ऊर्ध्वाधर शाफ्ट के माध्यम से पहुँचा जाता है।

- भाटिन, नरवापहाड़, तुरामडीह, बागजाता और मोहुलडीह झारखंड में संचालित अन्य भूमिगत यूरेनियम खदानें हैं।

- झारखंड में बंदुहुरांग को भारत की पहली ओपन-पिट यूरेनियम खदान के रूप में जाना जाता है।

- जादूगोड़ा क्षेत्र की खदानों से प्राप्त यूरेनियम अयस्क को भारत के परमाणु ऊर्जा कार्यक्रम में उपयोग के लिए संसाधित किया जाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the Indian Federal System?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी भारतीय संघीय व्यवस्था की विशेषता नहीं है?

options.label: A
options.text: Division of powers between the Centre and States through three lists in the Seventh Schedule
options.text_hi: सातवीं अनुसूची में तीन सूचियों के माध्यम से केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच शक्तियों का विभाजन

options.label: B
options.text: An independent judiciary with power of judicial review
options.text_hi: न्यायिक समीक्षा की शक्ति के साथ एक स्वतंत्र न्यायपालिका

options.label: C
options.text: Dual citizenship  -  separate citizenship for the Union and for each State
options.text_hi: दोहरी नागरिकता  -  संघ और प्रत्येक राज्य के लिए अलग नागरिकता

questions.correct_text: Dual citizenship  -  separate citizenship for the Union and for each State
questions.solution:
India has single citizenship - every Indian is a citizen of India, not of any particular State. This is unlike the USA where citizens have dual citizenship (federal and state). Single citizenship in India promotes national unity and integration.

Other options are genuine federal features of India. The Seventh Schedule's three lists (Union, State, Concurrent), judicial review, and constitutional supremacy are all classic federal characteristics.

Further insights:

India is described as a "quasi-federal" or "federal with unitary bias" system. Unitary features include: a single Constitution, single citizenship, the Governor appointed by the Centre, Parliament's power to alter state boundaries, emergency provisions that centralize power, and an Integrated Judicial System with the Supreme Court at the apex.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the nationwide rollout of E20 petrol in India from April 2026:

i) The Central Government mandated the nationwide sale of E20 petrol with a minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95 from 1 April 2026.

ii) The mandatory transition to E20 petrol is being implemented strictly according to guidelines issued by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए, जो अप्रैल 2026 से भारत में E20 पेट्रोल की राष्ट्रव्यापी शुरुआत के संबंध में हैं:

i) केंद्र सरकार ने 1 अप्रैल 2026 से न्यूनतम 95 रिसर्च ऑक्टेन नंबर (RON) वाले E20 पेट्रोल की राष्ट्रव्यापी बिक्री अनिवार्य कर दी।

ii) E20 पेट्रोल में अनिवार्य रूप से परिवर्तन, पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार सख्ती से लागू किया जा रहा है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement i and Statement ii
options.text_hi: कथन i और कथन ii दोनों

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement i nor Statement ii
options.text_hi: न तो कथन i और न ही कथन ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

The Central Government directed Oil Marketing Companies to sell E20 (20% ethanol-blended) petrol with a minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95 across all States and Union Territories from 1 April 2026.

The notification was issued by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

The implementation of the nationwide E20 rollout is governed by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas under the Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme and Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specifications, not by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Hindi:

केंद्र सरकार ने तेल विपणन कंपनियों को 1 अप्रैल 2026 से सभी राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में न्यूनतम 95 रिसर्च ऑक्टेन नंबर (RON) वाले E20 (20% इथेनॉल-मिश्रित) पेट्रोल की बिक्री करने का निर्देश दिया।

यह अधिसूचना पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी की गई थी।

E20 पेट्रोल के राष्ट्रव्यापी कार्यान्वयन का नियमन पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय द्वारा इथेनॉल ब्लेंडेड पेट्रोल (EBP) कार्यक्रम और भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (BIS) के विनिर्देशों के तहत किया जाता है, न कि पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय द्वारा।

questions.question: In the demographic history of India, which census year is officially designated as the "Year of the Great Divide" marking the transition toward sustained population growth?
questions.question_hi: भारत के जनसांख्यिकीय इतिहास में, किस जनगणना वर्ष को आधिकारिक तौर पर "महान विभाजक वर्ष" (Year of the Great Divide) के रूप में नामित किया गया है, जो निरंतर जनसंख्या वृद्धि की ओर संक्रमण को चिह्नित करता है?
questions.solution:
The year 1921 is known as the "Year of the Great Divide" in India's demographic history. Before 1921, population growth was slow and fluctuating, with the decade 1911 - 1921 even recording a decline. After 1921, India's population entered a phase of sustained and moderately increasing growth, making 1921 the major demographic dividing point.

Further Insights:

- The decade 1911 - 1921 was severely affected by the influenza epidemic of 1918 - 1919, which contributed to heavy mortality.

- The population growth pattern from 1901 to 1921 was characterised by slow and fluctuating growth.

- The period from 1921 to 1951 witnessed moderately increasing population growth.

- From 1951 onwards, declining death rates contributed significantly to the acceleration of India's population growth.

- Census records note that improved control of major causes of mortality contributed to the more sustained population growth observed after 1921.

Hindi:

अधिक जानकारी:

- 1911-1921 का दशक 1918-1919 की इन्फ्लूएंजा महामारी से गंभीर रूप से प्रभावित था, जिसने भारी मृत्यु दर में योगदान दिया।

- जनगणना रिकॉर्ड बताते हैं कि मृत्यु दर के प्रमुख कारणों के बेहतर नियंत्रण ने 1921 के बाद देखी गई अधिक निरंतर जनसंख्या वृद्धि में योगदान दिया।

questions.question:
With reference to classical Indian dance forms, consider the following statements regarding Manipuri Dance:

1. Unlike other Indian classical dances, the dancers do not wear heavy metallic ankle bells (ghungroos), and footwork is kept soft and light.

2. The Pung Cholom is a dynamic component of Manipuri dance where dancers play a drum while executing complex leaps and turns.

3. The costume of the female dancer features a stiff, barrel-shaped skirt called a Kumil, decorated with mirrors and embroidery.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैलियों के संदर्भ में, मणिपुरी नृत्य के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. अन्य भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्यों के विपरीत, नर्तक भारी धातु की टखने की घंटियाँ (घुंघरू) नहीं पहनते, और पदयात्रा को नरम और हल्का रखा जाता है।

2. पुंग चोलोम मणिपुरी नृत्य का एक गतिशील घटक है जहाँ नर्तक जटिल छलांगें और मोड़ करते हुए ढोल बजाते हैं।

3. महिला नर्तकी के वस्त्र में एक कठोर, बैरल के आकार की स्कर्ट होती है जिसे कुमिल कहा जाता है, जो दर्पणों और कढ़ाई से सजी होती है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Ankle bells are omitted in Manipuri dance to preserve the soft sound of feet contacting the floor, mirroring its devotion-centric style.

Statement 2 is correct: The Pung Cholom combines drumming and classical dance movements, requiring high athletic stamina.

Statement 3 is correct: The Kumil is a unique cylindrical skirt that gives the dance its distinct visual flow during spins.

Further insights:

Manipuri classical dance was brought to mainstream global attention by Rabindranath Tagore after he introduced it into the curriculum at Shantiniketan.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the history of the National Games of India:

I. The inaugural edition of the Indian Olympic Games was held at Lahore in 1924.

II. The first post-Independence edition of the National Games was hosted by the city of Lucknow in 1948.

III. The modern Olympic-format structure for the National Games was introduced during the edition held at New Delhi in 1985.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के राष्ट्रीय खेलों के इतिहास के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. भारतीय ओलंपिक खेलों का उद्घाटन संस्करण 1924 में लाहौर में आयोजित किया गया था।

II. स्वतंत्रता के बाद राष्ट्रीय खेलों के पहले संस्करण की मेजबानी 1948 में लखनऊ शहर द्वारा की गई थी।

III. राष्ट्रीय खेलों के लिए आधुनिक ओलंपिक-प्रारूप संरचना 1985 में नई दिल्ली में आयोजित संस्करण के दौरान पेश की गई थी।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct:

The first edition of the Indian Olympic Games was held at Lahore in undivided Punjab in 1924. The event developed from India's growing Olympic movement and was intended to provide a national platform for sporting talent. The first three editions of these Games were held in Lahore.

Statement II is correct:

Lucknow hosted the first edition of the National Games held after India attained Independence. This edition took place in 1948 and represented the continuation of the national multi-sport competition in independent India. Therefore, the city and year mentioned in Statement II are correctly matched.

Statement III is correct:

A major change occurred in 1985 when New Delhi hosted the first National Games conducted on the lines of the Olympic Games. Official records classify the 1985 New Delhi edition as the beginning of the National Games in the Olympic format. This marked an important stage in the development of India's national multi-sport competition.

Hindi:

भारतीय ओलंपिक खेलों का पहला संस्करण 1924 में अविभाजित पंजाब के लाहौर में आयोजित किया गया था। यह आयोजन भारत के बढ़ते ओलंपिक आंदोलन से विकसित हुआ और इसका उद्देश्य खेल प्रतिभाओं के लिए एक राष्ट्रीय मंच प्रदान करना था। इन खेलों के पहले तीन संस्करण लाहौर में आयोजित किए गए थे।

एक बड़ा बदलाव 1985 में हुआ जब नई दिल्ली ने ओलंपिक खेलों की तर्ज पर आयोजित पहले राष्ट्रीय खेलों की मेजबानी की। आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड 1985 के नई दिल्ली संस्करण को ओलंपिक प्रारूप में राष्ट्रीय खेलों की शुरुआत के रूप में वर्गीकृत करते हैं। इसने भारत की राष्ट्रीय बहु-खेल प्रतियोगिता के विकास में एक महत्वपूर्ण चरण को चिह्नित किया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Communal Award of 1932 and the subsequent Poona Pact:

Statement I: The Communal Award was officially announced by British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald on 16 August 1932 on the basis of the findings of the Lothian Committee.

Statement II: The Communal Award introduced separate electorates exclusively for Muslims and Europeans while completely denying separate political representation to the Depressed Classes.

Statement III: The historic Poona Pact abandoned separate electorates for the Depressed Classes in favour of joint electorates with an increased reservation of 147 seats in the provincial legislatures.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
1932 के सांप्रदायिक पंचाट (कम्युनल अवार्ड) और उसके बाद के पूना पैक्ट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: सांप्रदायिक पंचाट की आधिकारिक घोषणा ब्रिटिश प्रधान मंत्री रामसे मैकडोनाल्ड द्वारा 16 अगस्त 1932 को लोथियन समिति के निष्कर्षों के आधार पर की गई थी।

कथन II: सांप्रदायिक पंचाट ने विशेष रूप से मुसलमानों और यूरोपीय लोगों के लिए अलग निर्वाचक मंडल की शुरुआत की, जबकि दलित वर्गों को अलग राजनीतिक प्रतिनिधित्व देने से पूरी तरह इनकार कर दिया।

कथन III: ऐतिहासिक पूना पैक्ट ने प्रांतीय विधानसभाओं में 147 सीटों के बढ़े हुए आरक्षण के साथ संयुक्त निर्वाचक मंडल के पक्ष में दलित वर्गों के लिए अलग निर्वाचक मंडल को त्याग दिया।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: B
options.text: Only Statement I and Statement II
options.text_hi: केवल कथन I और कथन II

options.label: C
options.text: Only Statement II and Statement III
options.text_hi: केवल कथन II और कथन III

options.label: D
options.text: Statement I, Statement II and Statement III
options.text_hi: कथन I, कथन II और कथन III

questions.solution:
Only Statement I is correct.

Statement I is correct

The Communal Award was announced by British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald on 16 August 1932.

It was based on the findings of the Indian Franchise Committee, commonly known as the Lothian Committee, which had examined questions relating to franchise and political representation.

Statement II is incorrect

The Communal Award did not provide separate electorates exclusively to Muslims and Europeans.

It extended separate representation to several communities and also provided separate electorates for the Depressed Classes.

Statement III is incorrect

The Poona Pact provided 148 reserved seats for the Depressed Classes in the provincial legislatures, not 147.

It replaced separate electorates for the Depressed Classes with reserved seats under a joint electorate arrangement.

Further insights:

- The Poona Pact was concluded on 24 September 1932.

- B.R. Ambedkar played a central role in negotiations concerning the political representation of the Depressed Classes.

- Mahatma Gandhi undertook a fast while imprisoned in Yeravda Central Jail in Poona.

- The Poona Pact also envisaged fair representation of the Depressed Classes in public services, subject to educational qualifications.

Hindi:

कथन I सही है

सांप्रदायिक पंचाट (कम्युनल अवार्ड) की घोषणा ब्रिटिश प्रधान मंत्री रामसे मैकडोनाल्ड ने 16 अगस्त 1932 को की थी।

यह भारतीय मताधिकार समिति, जिसे आमतौर पर लोथियन समिति के रूप में जाना जाता है, के निष्कर्षों पर आधारित था, जिसने मताधिकार और राजनीतिक प्रतिनिधित्व से संबंधित प्रश्नों की जांच की थी।

सांप्रदायिक पंचाट ने विशेष रूप से मुसलमानों और यूरोपीय लोगों को अलग निर्वाचक मंडल प्रदान नहीं किया।
